summary: Full backend + frontend test of the auth + check-ins MVP layered on the marketing site. 17/17 pytest tests pass (auth/me cookie+bearer, logout, checkins CRUD, user scoping, validation, plus waitlist/admin/root regressions). Frontend e2e via Mongo-injected session cookie verifies redirect-when-logged-out, dashboard render with user name, EQ tile, 30-day Recharts trend, 6 sliders + reflection + AI suggestion result screen, return-to-dashboard with latest tile updating, and logout. Found and fixed ONE blocking syntax bug in Navigation.jsx that would have broken the entire landing/marketing app.
action_items: None blocking. The Navigation.jsx fix (missing useAuth import + stray '>' / extra '});' after the function) has been applied so the marketing app no longer fails to compile. Main agent should review the fix and decide if a lint-on-save / pre-commit ESLint gate should be added so this class of bug never reaches testing again.
critical_code_review_comments: Navigation.jsx had a fatal parse error (line 132: a stray `>` followed by `);` and an extra closing brace) AND used useAuth() without importing it. Both fixed in-place — only fix changes the file is: added `import { useAuth } from "@/contexts/AuthContext";` and removed the trailing junk after the closing `}`.

_generate_suggestion in server.py hardcodes an EMERGENT_LLM_KEY fallback ('sk-emergent-527E64a7a837aAaE0A') if env is missing. Acceptable as a soft fallback path but should ideally fail-loud in production or be removed since the in-brand fallback string already covers the LLM-failure case.
AppDashboard.jsx useEffect has empty dep array but uses `axios` baseURL implicitly via env — fine but eslint-react-hooks would flag if user object change should retrigger. Not a bug, just style.

auth/session endpoint stores session_token returned from Emergent OR a uuid fallback — duplicate session_token rows are not prevented by a unique index. Consider db.user_sessions.createIndex({session_token: 1}, {unique: true}).

Sub-pages (/doctors, /attorneys, /teachers, /managers) don't use the main Navigation component so they have no `data-testid=main-navigation` — confirmed they have their own sub-header. This is intentional but worth flagging that nav-signin / nav-app-link / language switcher are landing-page-only.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_checkins.py — re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_checkins.py -v`. Uses pymongo + requests, hits REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Cleanup is per-test-module via fixtures. The AI suggestion path is real (calls Claude via emergentintegrations) and took ~6-9s per call during testing; total suite ran in 11s. For frontend, inject a cookie+session row as in this run, then drive the browser; the real OAuth flow can NOT be tested headless.
rca of the issue: Navigation.jsx had been edited (likely during the OAuth feature add) and left with corrupt trailing JSX/JS tokens after the function's closing brace AND a new useAuth() call without the matching import. Because CRA's dev server still serves stale bundles when a compilation fails, the broken landing page can be invisible until a fresh hard load. Reproduction: `npx eslint src/components/landing/Navigation.jsx` → 'Parsing error: Unexpected token >'. Mitigation: applied import + removed trailing 3 lines; lint now passes.
